title: Zephyrine and the Radiators
author: Isandro Brightwater
blurb: Silas Thornbury, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
